title: Record the review of phase 1: one finding, fixed, and two items filed
message:
Record the review of phase 1: one finding, fixed, and two items filed

The plan gains the review's finding and its fix, the verification on the
fix commit, and the two work items the review left: #28 for the writers
that save an object's first ability only, #29 for the ability lists and
the preview object that downgrade and applyoil leave behind. Phase 2 gains
what a second run on the same database showed of its test.

title: Keep the rest of an object's abilities when its saved ability loads
message:
Keep the rest of an object's abilities when its saved ability loads

The object writers store only the first ability of an object's list.
objsave_replace_special_ability() freed the whole list and installed that
one record, so a prototype-backed object with more than one ability loaded
with the first alone. Until the previous commit a first ability with no
command word was rejected, and the prototype's list survived by that
accident; accepting the record cut #1213, #1244 and #20621 down to one
ability on every load.

The record now replaces the ability of its kind, or else the first one,
and the rest of the list stays. By kind, not by position: parse_object()
puts each record in front and an OLC save writes the list in order, so the
abilities change places at the boot after a zone save. A first ability
that has a command word keeps the rest as well, which it did not before
this merge request either.

Test: the two abilities of #1213 through the file loader and the player-row
loader, then with the prototype's list the other way round, with a first
ability that has a command word, and with an ability of a kind the
prototype does not have.

Found in review of MR !23. Work item #19.

title: Load a saved special ability that has no command word
message:
Load a saved special ability that has no command word

The object writers store an ability as seven numbers and its command word,
and the word is empty for an ability that fires on hit or on a critical
hit. objsave_replace_special_ability() required eight fields, so every
loader rejected such a record: the file, player and sheath loaders logged
"Invalid SpAb record" and left the object with only its prototype's
abilities, and the pet loader rejected the pet's whole object set.

The parser now accepts seven numbers and leaves the command word NULL, as
the world loader does for a prototype, and still rejects fewer than seven.

Tests: an ability with no command word is saved and loaded through the
file, player and pet paths and compared; a six-number record is still
rejected by the pet decoder.

Work item #19.

title: Pass over an ability with no command word when a word is uttered
message:
Pass over an ability with no command word when a word is uttered

An ability can answer to a command word and have none set: the world
loader stores NULL for a prototype's seven-field record, and a builder can
set the activation method without setting the word. `utter` compared every
such ability's word with strcmp(), so any uttered word crashed the server
while the object was wielded or worn.

process_weapon_abilities() and process_armor_abilities() now skip an
ability whose command word is not set. Found while fixing work item #19,
whose loader fix restores these abilities from saved objects.
